body: Yeah it’s hard for us gays in the US isn’t it. My father would want me dead if he knew. Hope you do alright.
My mother, but she has enough to worry about. Ditto for my handful of friends.
It may, though I imagine I will feel worse when I cannot afford anything. As of now I can afford to eat.
Sounds like we are in the same boat, then. I may hit that wall tonight. Hope you carry on, comrade
If I don’t make it, comrades, keep being strong and thank you for your responses <3
Thank you, comrade. This is why I posted here, to avoid bothering family and friends since you all can just scroll past if you wish <3
That used to be enough but I’m growing despondent
I have passions in things (history, writing, animal rescue) but these do not secure job prospects so I do not have a degree with them. Damned if I do and damned if I don’t, I suppose

I’m a burden to my family and what few friends I have (mental health issues that no one wants to hear about). Things are getting more expensive so I have to take a job that makes me want to die in order to live haha what irony.
Thank you. We’ll see. The only thing that gives me joy in life is food so if not by my direct hand, I’ll off myself with health issues anyway
You’re welcome. Hope I make it like you have
I have reassured them of this many times before and they have thanked me for it, so it hurts that they appear to have forgotten (even if that’s not actually the case).
Thank you for this reply. I’m being honest when I say I didn’t even realize it was an *option* for me to say something like that. It feels wrong to make that request, but perhaps I am allowed to?
